verdict.rationale: The evidence shows records can be sent and managed through the Search API (algolia-docs-4, algolia-docs-54), the CLI is suited to scripts and CI (algolia-docs-2), and Algolia-managed connectors handle schedules and retries (algolia-docs-48). Community users report running indices of about 1.5M records and enterprise scale of 10B+ (algolia-comm-18, algolia-comm-8). However, nothing in the pack documents a batch/bulk import endpoint, import throughput, or async task IDs and completion tracking. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk indexing API, evidence of import speed at millions of records, async task status or wait-for-completion tracking.
